summary: V3-08 repair accepted. Root cause of the trusted finalizer failure (Actions run 35544223219, reopen commit bb0ad36 at 2026-09-21T00:00:57Z): the finalizer workflow triggered at the 23:57 UTC schedule slot on Sunday Sept 20, 2026, and the 'Trusted product, privacy and cost gates' step executed the jest suite just after midnight UTC on Monday Sept 21, 2026. Two V3-04 test files (cost-gates-v3-04.test.ts and materialized-balances.test.ts) asserted exact 'week' period balances over fixed test data dated 2026-09-16 while calling computePeriodContributionBalances/computePeriodFinancialBalances with the default referenceDate = new Date(). On Monday Sept 21 the week boundary moved to 2026-09-21T00:00:00Z, excluding the Sept 16 entries, so the week view became empty and the exact assertions (e.g. weekBalances.get('a') === -2.5) failed, failing the trusted gates step and triggering reopen-on-failure. The candidate fixes exactly this blocker by pinning referenceDate to new Date('2026-09-16T14:00:00.000Z') in the three week-view calls (1 in cost-gates-v3-04.test.ts, 2 in materialized-balances.test.ts), making the week boundary deterministically Monday Sept 14 so the Sept 16 entries stay inside the week and the 2020 settlement stays outside; every expected value and the test intent (settlement outside period does not affect the period view) are preserved. The delta vs the pristine accepted tree is strictly the two test files (7 insertions, 4 deletions) plus the new trusted log; no product code, governance, directives, release-state or config file is touched. Trusted verification exit code is 0: typecheck PASS, 451/451 tests PASS (22 suites), privacy check PASS (71 tests), cost regression gate PASS (21/21), expo export PASS, prebuild PASS, Android debug build BUILD SUCCESSFUL in 19m47s. Independent re-verification reproduces all green results: npm run typecheck PASS, full jest suite 451/451 PASS, privacy 71/71 PASS, cost gate 21/21 PASS, v3-08-finalizer-wrapper + v3-08-e2e-golden-path 35/35 PASS. A failure-mode simulation confirms the unfixed tests fail with now=2026-09-21T00:00:30Z (week boundary Sept 21, entries excluded, balance 0 vs expected -2.5) and pass deterministically with the pinned reference date; boundary math was also checked across UTC-12..UTC+14 and the Sept 16 entries always remain inside the pinned week. A full audit of every remaining new Date() usage and every period call in the test suite found no other instance with exact period-boundary assertions over fixed dates (the rest are timestamp-only CRUD/write-count/property tests, loose bounds, zero-sum-only or no-mutation-only assertions, or entries computed relative to now). All previously accepted V3 invariants (zero-sum ledgers, integer minor-unit money, Minutes/Points separation, materialized balances == ledger replay, cost gates 50k-entry bounded reads / 0-read tab switching / delta-only sync / bounded writes / classification cache, analytics/privacy separation, no chrono/premium/paywall/warm-V2/cross-currency/silent-conversion) are regress-free. No must-fix finding remains. Decision: accept.
